name: fal-ai
description: fal.ai shared MCP and task CLI for current models, queue receipts, asset management, private accounts and exact approved generation batches.
long_description: Shared model/queue/Assets workflows with mandatory explicit approval, isolated API-key profiles and exact generation batch review. Official hosted OAuth connection remains separate.

token_file.title: Private token-only file
token_file.description: Absolute owner-private token-only account key file; overrides selected key.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide and directly refuse mutations and private output file writes.

api_key.title: Account API key
api_key.description: Private fal API key for this intended account; separate from OAuth relay sessions.

allow_destructive.title: Allow confirmed mutations
allow_destructive.description: Permit mutation execution only when the tool call explicitly confirms the exact action. Disable to refuse all mutations.
